name: Account Baseline Setup & Connection Health Verification
purpose: Verify OAuth tokens, system permissions, account currency, timezones, and conversion baseline tracking across all platforms before launching campaigns.
triggerConditions: New platform connection added in Connection Hub
Periodic monthly account health verification check
prerequisites: Valid direct platform credentials present in environment or encrypted store
Client workspace created with target currency and operational timezone
Billing profile active on target platform ad accounts

executionSteps.name: Verify Platform API Credentials
executionSteps.action: Verify OAuth tokens, token scopes, and test API ping to Google Ads, Meta Graph, and TikTok Business APIs

executionSteps.name: Validate Currency & Timezone Alignment
executionSteps.action: Ensure ad account currency matches workspace currency and ad delivery timezones match client operational hours

executionSteps.name: Verify Base Tracking Pixels & Webhooks
executionSteps.action: Verify Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager container, and TikTok Pixel base scripts are receiving pageviews

executionSteps.name: Verify Billing & Spend Limits
executionSteps.action: Confirm account status is ACTIVE with no outstanding balance suspensions or restrictive account-level spend caps

successCriteria: 100% of target platforms return HTTP 200 on health probes
Currency parity confirmed between client workspace and ad accounts
Tracking base signals active within last 24 hours

failureHandling.retryStrategy: Retry failed connection probe 3 times with 5s exponential backoff

rollbackStrategy: Mark failing platform connection as DEGRADED; isolate unaffected platforms and send immediate token refresh link to user.
